novelty_search.nearest_result: Has/had MLP4's exact left-change plus right-change response writes a downstream contextual source bank; is/was reuses L9H1/H4 and reads primarily from contextualized moment and determiner tokens, but its upstream writer has not been tested.
novelty_search.new_question: Does the same exact MLP4 bilinear response organization causally write the moment-plus-determiner source bank for is/was on a fresh capability-qualified population?

population: All 32 A1/A2 rows from the matched-v2 is/was authority: 16 novel occupations, equal-length base/donor pairs differing only at aligned this/that, with native capability scored separately by family, direction, and side.

operator.source_bank: The two positions immediately downstream of the unique this/that difference: contextualized moment and following determiner.
operator.exact_factorization: At MLP4, decompose donor-minus-base Down(Left(z) elementwise-multiplied by Right(z)) into left_change, right_change, and bilinear_interaction using the fixed native weights and no fit.
operator.arms: All eight factor subsets plus the direct donor-minus-base MLP4-output ceiling, applied only at the frozen two-token source bank before the exact blocks5-17 suffix.
operator.no_rescue: No source, module, term, row, threshold, or task-specific coefficient change after execution.

bars.capability: Base and donor accuracy >=0.85 in every A1/A2 x direction x side cell.
bars.instrument: Manual/native selected logits <=1e-4; exact three-factor FP32 reconstruction <=2e-3; full-factor versus direct-ceiling scored logits <=1e-4; finite complete coverage.
bars.live_writer: Full three-factor source-bank intervention has mean recovery >=0.20, positive mean recovery and direction fraction >=0.75 separately in A1 and A2.
bars.shared_two_term_program: The frozen has/had terms left_change+right_change retain >=0.80 of the full-factor mean recovery and have direction fraction >=0.75 separately in A1 and A2.
bars.factor_structure: Both left_change and right_change have positive exact-factorial Shapley contribution, and absolute bilinear-interaction Shapley contribution is <=0.25 of absolute full recovery.
bars.price: At most 26 forwards/416 examples, nine causal arms, no fitting/search/backward/update.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: All hashes, row structure, native capability, exact factor closure, manual/native agreement, and coverage pass.
predictions.pred_b_live_mlp4_contextual_source_write: The full exact MLP4 response at moment plus determiner clears the live writer bars.
predictions.pred_c_shared_left_right_two_term_progra: The frozen has/had two-term program retains at least 80% with directional effects in both is/was families.
predictions.pred_d_shared_factor_structure: Left and right changes are both positive contributors and the mixed interaction remains secondary.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: The declared forward/example price and zero-fit/search/update constraints hold exactly.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: MLP4's exact two-term bilinear contextualization operation is reused upstream of the shared L9H1/H4 reader architecture.
terminal.null: Instrument passes but writer magnitude or factor-structure reuse misses; retain shared downstream readers without a shared upstream writer.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, factor closure, manual/native agreement, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.
